stories.title: Greenland Tech Holding beats earnings and revenue estimates
stories.summary: Greenland Tech Holding reported quarterly earnings that beat estimates by $0.08 per share. Revenue also topped analyst forecasts, per Investing.com. The report gives no further detail on drivers of the beat.
stories.whyItMatters: A beat on both earnings and revenue can lift investor confidence in the stock.
whatToWatch: Management's guidance for the next quarter
Analyst reaction and any price target changes
questions: Does the company raise its guidance?

stories.title: ACNB director buys $250 in company stock
stories.summary: ACNB director Frank Elsner III bought $250 worth of company stock, according to a regulatory filing. The same filing shows he also received compensation. The trade is small in size.
stories.whyItMatters: Insider buys offer a public record of director confidence, though a trade this small signals little on its own.
questions: Is this purchase part of a recurring compensation plan?

stories.title: Ibotta 10% owner KDT Holdings sells $11.7 million in stock
stories.summary: KDT Ibotta Holdings, a holder of more than 10% of Ibotta, sold $11.7 million worth of Ibotta stock. The sale is recorded in a regulatory filing that does not state a reason.
stories.whyItMatters: Large sales by major shareholders can pressure a stock's price and point to reduced insider ownership.
whatToWatch: Whether KDT Holdings keeps reducing its stake
Ibotta's stock reaction to the filing
questions: Why did the holder sell now?
How much of the stake remains?

stories.title: FAA says router overload in Arkansas caused nationwide flight grounding
stories.summary: A router overload at an FAA facility in Arkansas triggered a nationwide grounding of flights, the Wall Street Journal reported. The outage hit air traffic systems across the country.
stories.whyItMatters: A nationwide flight grounding disrupts airline operations and can hit airline stocks and travel-linked sectors.
whatToWatch: FAA statements on the cause and the fix
Airline schedule recovery and any compensation costs
questions: How long did the grounding last?
Could this happen again without infrastructure upgrades?

stories.title: Copa Airlines and UPS planes collide while taxiing in Miami
stories.summary: A Copa Airlines plane and a UPS plane collided while taxiing at Miami International Airport, Investing.com reported. The report does not state whether there were injuries or how much damage occurred.
stories.whyItMatters: Ground collisions raise safety and operational questions for the airlines involved and can affect flights at a major hub.
whatToWatch: Any flight delays or cancellations tied to the incident

stories.whyItMatters: China's economic path affects global trade, commodity demand, and markets tied to Chinese growth.
whatToWatch: Policy signals from Beijing on growth targets
questions: What does ING see as the biggest risk?
How do these questions differ from last year's?

Further statements from Saudi authorities on damage or casualties

stories.title: U.S. diesel prices fall below $6 a gallon to a two-month low
stories.summary: U.S. diesel prices dropped below $6 a gallon, their lowest level in two months, Investing.com reported. Diesel is a key cost input for freight and trucking.
stories.whyItMatters: Lower diesel prices ease a major cost for freight and trucking companies and can factor into inflation readings.
whatToWatch: Crude oil price trends that drive diesel costs
questions: What is driving the price drop?
Will lower diesel costs reach consumers?
